LolSikins - third-party notices
===============================

LolSikins is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0.txt). It comes with NO WARRANTY.
The complete source code of this version is in LolSikins-source.zip.

LolSikins is a modified version of cslol-manager by LeagueToolkit (https://github.com/LeagueToolkit/cslol-manager,
GPL-3.0), changed in 2026: new interface, skin store, languages, and the patcher described below.
LolSikins is not official and is not endorsed by or affiliated with League Toolkit or Riot Games.

Patcher (patcher\ltk_patcher_host.exe, patcher\ltk_patcher_dll.dll)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
Patcher binaries from LTK Manager by League Toolkit (https://github.com/LeagueToolkit/ltk-manager), redistributed
under the LTK Patcher License (LTK-PATCHER-LICENSE.md). As that license requires, League Toolkit's code signature
has been removed. If the files are signed, the signature is LolSikins' own. Their code is otherwise unchanged.

Qt 5.15.18 (statically linked into LolSikins.exe)
------------------------------------------------
The Qt Toolkit is Copyright (C) The Qt Company Ltd. and other contributors, used under the GNU Lesser General Public
License v3.0 (LGPL-3.0.txt, which adds to GPL-3.0.txt). Qt source code: https://download.qt.io/archive/qt/5.15/
To relink LolSikins with a modified Qt, build LolSikins-source.zip against your Qt (see CMakeLists.txt).

--------------------------------------------------
